name: Payout Press
concept: A continuous milestone ribbon gives the qualified figure one physical surface, with three overlapping deposit/mid/final plates and five open supporting notes.
silhouette: one broad minted press strip with slanted stage plates above a 2+3 open note ledger
interaction: A single in-view engraving travels through the three supplied stage labels. All text and plates are visible without JavaScript or motion.
safety: ₹4.2L and Reply under 2m carry adjacent illustrative qualifications; stage plates are labels, not transaction records.
